description: Day-by-day overview of one Roadcut road trip: from, to, km and where to sleep each day, highlights, ferries, seasonal mountain passes on the way, a cost estimate, EV charging along the road (stations, fast chargers, longest stretch without one), and links to the full plan and the interactive planner. A trip is identified by its slug.

lang.description: Language of the user, for the links (en, de, es, fr, it, cs, da, sv, nb, pl, nl). Default en.

travel_date.description: When the user will drive (YYYY-MM-DD), to check seasonal passes. Default today.

name: get_road_trip
title: Get a road trip overview
